hard_rules: field registration is not search exposure
route labels must be enforced by compiler and evaluator, not documentation only
market-scope fields cannot be direct stock cross-sectional ranks
latched observations cannot be treated as lifecycle states
one event episode receives one vote
no claim of ineffectiveness without non-zero proposal, admission and strict execution
no claim of validation before an independent challenge release
